verdict.rationale: Datadog's official Dashboards documentation (datadog-docs-12) confirms a dedicated dashboarding product, and community feedback corroborates rich visualization types like the hexagon host map and flame graphs (datadog-comm-12, datadog-comm-11), which are hallmark Datadog dashboard widgets. However, the evidence pack does not explicitly cite template variables or dashboard-sharing mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/evidence of template variables and sharing/permissions workflow for dashboards.
